description: Java class 'MusicProvider' that fetches and manages a media catalog from a server, including JSON parsing, caching, and media metadata handling.

classes.name: MusicProvider
classes.description: Utility class to retrieve, cache, and provide access to music media metadata from a server-side JSON catalog.

methods.name: getGenres
methods.description: Returns an iterable of available music genres if initialized.

methods.name: getMusicsByGenre
methods.description: Returns an iterable of MediaMetadata objects for a specified genre.

methods.name: searchMusic
methods.description: Searches for music tracks with titles containing the given query.

methods.name: getMusic
methods.description: Retrieves MediaMetadata for a specific music ID.

methods.name: updateMusic
methods.description: Updates metadata for a given music ID and rebuilds genre lists if needed.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Marks a track as favorite or not.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a track is marked as favorite.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the media catalog has been initialized.

methods.name: retrieveMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches media catalog from server and caches data.

methods.name: retrieveMedia
methods.description: Fetches and parses JSON media catalog from server.

methods.name: buildFromJSON
methods.description: Creates MediaMetadata object from JSON data.

methods.name: fetchJSONFromUrl
methods.description: Downloads and parses JSON data from a URL.
